title: Stop measuring inside a filled world
summary: This meets comparison when scarcity has entered the eyes. The line interrupts it by naming the Divine already pervading every color and form.
takeaway: Do not compete inside a filled world.
lifeApplication: When someone else's beauty, success, or ease unsettles you, lift the gaze out of the comparison frame. Let pervasiveness replace scarcity before envy hardens.

source.shortMeaning: The Divine already fills every form the mind keeps comparing.
source.lifeApplication: When comparison starts, widen the gaze until scarcity loses its grip.
